name: net-trusted-set
note: `$trusted` expands the curated host set into a fine-grained net allow (proxy Auto). An unlisted IP target (1.1.1.1) is not a set member, so egress is denied end-to-end; the negative control proves the deny is real. The set's ADMISSION of listed hosts is proven at the compiler level (HostMatcher) — a real allowed connect would depend on live network + DNS to a third party, which this suite deliberately avoids.
